title: SC-GNN: A Communication-Efficient Semantic Compression for Distributed Training of GNNs
problem: Distributed GNN training incurs massive cross-partition communication overhead during forward and backward propagation to collect embeddings and gradients. Existing approaches based on sampling, quantization, or delaying are bounded by a Pareto frontier limiting further acceleration.
motivation: Reducing communication overhead is critical for scaling GNN training in distributed systems, as communication dominates overall training time.
method: SC-GNN reduces communication during distributed graph neural network training by grouping connections that need to travel between different computer partitions into semantic units—high-level bundles that preserve the structure and relationships of the original connections. Rather than transmitting each connection separately, it sends these bundled groups, reducing the total amount of data that needs to cross between computers. Finally, it uses connection-pattern analysis to identify and remove weak links from the bundles while keeping training accuracy the same.
key_novelty: SC-GNN groups cross-partition connections as semantic bundles for transmission instead of optimizing each connection individually.
contributions: Proposes semantic compression for cross-partition communication in distributed GNN training
Introduces connection-pattern based differential optimization for pruning weak connections
Achieves 40.8× higher compression rate than state-of-the-art methods
Reduces average epoch time to 31.8% of baseline on multi-field datasets
